LanguageData.Rimblings.Description: Pawns speak when they start social interactions. Zoom and distance control what you hear.
LanguageData.Rimblings.SectionSpeechDesc: Choose whose voices play and how they sound.
LanguageData.Rimblings.SectionHearingDesc: Voices fade as you zoom out or move the camera away.
LanguageData.Rimblings.SectionMixingDesc: Control how voices share the mix when pawns speak at once.
LanguageData.Rimblings.EnabledDesc: Turn all Rimblings voices on or off.
LanguageData.Rimblings.FullZoomDesc: Voices play at full zoom-based volume at or below this camera size. Smaller sizes mean a closer view.
LanguageData.Rimblings.SilentZoomDesc: Voices fade to silence by this camera size. It must be larger than the full-volume size.
LanguageData.Rimblings.HearingRadiusDesc: Voices outside this distance are silent, even off-screen.
LanguageData.Rimblings.Ducking: Background voices when a speaker is focused
LanguageData.Rimblings.DuckingDesc: Set how loud other voices remain when one pawn is focused.
LanguageData.Rimblings.MaxVoicesDesc: Extra overlapping voices may be skipped at this cap.
LanguageData.Rimblings.LimitVoicesDesc: Leave off for no simultaneous voice cap.
LanguageData.Rimblings.NonPlayerDesc: Also hear visitors, raiders and other humanlike pawns.
LanguageData.Rimblings.ShortenWordsDesc: Use each word's first and last letters for shorter speech.
